_note: Key path: exact_aspect -> guidance_mode. Feeds the guidance_line rendered field (the actionable follow-up sentence that pairs with meaning_primary). guidance_mode is computed by generate.py's _weekly_guidance_mode(planet, aspect_character) and only depends on which broad character group (flowing vs challenging) the exact_aspect belongs to, so the reachable mode set differs by aspect group rather than being a full grid: flowing aspects (Conjunction, Sextile, Trine) reach action/receiving/structure/adjustment/discernment/pacing/visibility; challenging aspects (Square, Opposition, Semisquare, Sesquiquadrate, Quincunx) reach conversation/discernment/structure/adjustment/pacing/visibility ('action' and 'receiving' never occur on a challenging aspect; 'conversation' never occurs on a flowing one). This mirrors moment_guidance.json's aspect_character -> guidance_mode shape at exact-aspect grain instead of broad-character grain. Variant-key rotation (v1/v2/v3 per README convention) is not wired into this file yet -- add variant leaves under a mode once volume warrants it; a single TODO string per mode is enough for the selector to resolve today. Leaves are TODO placeholders; until authored, generate.py falls back to the existing moment_guidance.json output for reader_guidance.

Conjunction._note: Conjunction guidance: the transiting energy and the natal target are fused for the duration -- guidance should help the reader use the merge on purpose rather than being swept by it.
Conjunction.action: Choose one deliberate move that lets this contact become usable now, rather than letting its intensity decide the whole direction for you.
Conjunction.receiving: Let the signal arrive before you answer it; what is merging with you needs room to be felt, not immediately managed.
Conjunction.structure: Give this concentrated energy a clear container, schedule, boundary, or sequence so it can work through you without taking over.
Conjunction.adjustment: Notice where the fusion is too tight, then make the smallest shift that lets both parts of the pattern breathe.
Conjunction.discernment: Separate urgency from truth; the fact that something feels immediate does not mean every response has to happen at once.
Conjunction.pacing: Move close enough to engage the moment, but leave enough space to notice whether the contact is building clarity or heat.
Conjunction.visibility: Name what is becoming impossible to keep separate, especially where your presence, role, or desire now needs to be seen plainly.
Conjunction.fallback: Treat this as a point of concentration: work with what has come together, but do not let intensity become your only guide.

Sextile._note: Sextile guidance: an opening that needs participation to become real -- guidance should point at the small available action, not passive luck.
Sextile.action: Take the available opening seriously enough to do one concrete thing with it; this support becomes real through participation.
Sextile.receiving: Let help, timing, or invitation meet you halfway, then respond before the opening stays theoretical.
Sextile.structure: Put a light framework around the opportunity so it has somewhere to land without becoming heavier than it needs to be.
Sextile.adjustment: Make the small correction that allows the opening to connect with your actual life instead of remaining a nice idea.
Sextile.discernment: Look for the door that is already slightly open, not the one you have to force to prove the moment is meaningful.
Sextile.pacing: Engage the chance at a human scale; a modest response now may do more than an overbuilt plan.
Sextile.visibility: Let the opening be visible enough that the right person, choice, or next step can recognize you in return.
Sextile.fallback: Use what is available, but meet it actively; this is an invitation that needs a response, not luck that performs by itself.

Trine._note: Trine guidance: natural fluency between the two functions -- guidance should name the specific resource on offer so it reads as usable, not vague good fortune.
Trine.action: Use the ease while it is available, and turn fluency into a chosen action instead of assuming it will act on your behalf.
Trine.receiving: Receive the support without minimizing it; what comes naturally here still deserves your attention and trust.
Trine.structure: Give the smoothness a form it can keep using, so a helpful current becomes a repeatable resource rather than a passing mood.
Trine.adjustment: Let the path of least resistance show you what no longer needs to be made difficult.
Trine.discernment: Notice what works without strain, then ask whether it is truly aligned or simply familiar.
Trine.pacing: Do not rush the ease just because it is moving well; let the rhythm carry you without turning it into urgency.
Trine.visibility: Allow what is already working in you to be seen, especially where hiding it would make the gift harder to share.
Trine.fallback: Trust the fluency, but stay awake inside it; ease is most useful when it becomes conscious.

Square._note: Square guidance: productive friction between two functions that want different things -- guidance should point at adjustment, not a verdict on which side is right.
Square.conversation: Have the conversation where the mismatch actually lives, not around it; both needs become easier to work with once named clearly.
Square.structure: Build a firmer container around the friction so the competing demands have rules, timing, and limits instead of colliding at random.
Square.adjustment: Change the angle of approach before you decide one side must win; the strain may be asking for coordination, not conquest.
Square.discernment: Identify which part of the tension is useful information and which part is old reaction repeating under a new name.
Square.pacing: Slow the response enough to keep friction productive, but do not wait so long that avoidance starts making the choice for you.
Square.visibility: Let the conflict show you what can no longer stay politely hidden, especially where a clearer stance is overdue.
Square.fallback: Treat the friction as movement trying to happen; adjust the pattern before turning it into a verdict.

Opposition._note: Opposition guidance: a tension to be held between two poles rather than resolved by fully picking one -- guidance should keep both ends in the sentence.
Opposition.conversation: Keep both ends of the tension in the room; the useful conversation is the one that can hear contrast without collapsing it into blame.
Opposition.structure: Create an agreement, boundary, or rhythm that gives each side a place, instead of letting one pole impersonate the whole truth.
Opposition.adjustment: Shift from either-or to proportion; the correction may be about how much weight each side gets, not which one disappears.
Opposition.discernment: Ask what belongs to you, what belongs to the other side, and what only appears when the two are facing each other.
Opposition.pacing: Let the tension show its shape before resolving it; moving too fast may only replace one imbalance with another.
Opposition.visibility: Make the contrast visible without dramatizing it, especially where being seen by another person clarifies your own position.
Opposition.fallback: Hold the polarity long enough to learn from both sides; this aspect is asking for relationship, not instant resolution.

Semisquare._note: Semisquare guidance: low-grade friction, an irritant more than a crisis -- guidance should be sized proportionately, useful as an early signal rather than a call to overhaul.
Semisquare.conversation: Say the small thing before it becomes the large thing; a brief, specific conversation may clear more than extended tolerance.
Semisquare.structure: Tighten the loose screw rather than rebuilding the whole machine; this friction is asking for maintenance-sized structure.
Semisquare.adjustment: Make the minor correction now, especially where irritation is pointing to a habit that has drifted out of tune.
Semisquare.discernment: Do not inflate the annoyance, but do not ignore it either; it may be the first sign that something needs a cleaner fit.
Semisquare.pacing: Pause just long enough to respond accurately; this does not require a dramatic slowdown, only less automatic momentum.
Semisquare.visibility: Let the small signal be acknowledged without making it the whole story, especially where quiet resentment would otherwise accumulate.
Semisquare.fallback: Read this as an early warning light, not a crisis; a measured correction is usually enough.

Sesquiquadrate._note: Sesquiquadrate guidance: a secondary adjustment point, often a nagging correction that shows up after an earlier signal was missed -- guidance can reference catching up, not starting over.
Sesquiquadrate.conversation: Return to the conversation that should have happened earlier, and keep it specific enough to repair the missed signal.
Sesquiquadrate.structure: Add the support, boundary, or sequence that the pattern has already shown it needed; this is catch-up structure, not punishment.
Sesquiquadrate.adjustment: Make the follow-up correction now, especially where a previous compromise no longer holds under real conditions.
Sesquiquadrate.discernment: Look for the second signal beneath the irritation; something is repeating because the first message was not fully integrated.
Sesquiquadrate.pacing: Do not rush to compensate for the delay; catch up by moving accurately, not by overcorrecting.
Sesquiquadrate.visibility: Acknowledge what has become harder to overlook, especially where a small omission is now affecting the larger pattern.
Sesquiquadrate.fallback: Treat this as a delayed correction point; you are not starting over, but the pattern does need a cleaner response.

Quincunx._note: Quincunx guidance: a mismatch between two functions that do not naturally relate -- guidance should point at deliberate translation between them, not force.
Quincunx.conversation: Translate before you negotiate; the two sides may be using different languages even when they seem to be discussing the same issue.
Quincunx.structure: Build a bridge between mismatched needs with explicit terms, steps, and expectations, rather than assuming they will naturally understand each other.
Quincunx.adjustment: Make a precise adaptation instead of forcing compatibility; the goal is workable translation, not perfect symmetry.
Quincunx.discernment: Name what does not naturally fit, then decide what can be translated, what needs space, and what should not be forced.
Quincunx.pacing: Give the mismatch time to reveal its logic; moving too quickly may turn unfamiliarity into unnecessary resistance.
Quincunx.visibility: Let the awkward fit be visible enough to work with, especially where pretending it is simple would create more strain later.
Quincunx.fallback: Approach the mismatch as a translation problem; force will distort it, but deliberate adaptation can make it livable.

fallback._note: Fallback for an exact_aspect that has not been mapped yet.
fallback.fallback: Use this contact as information about timing, proportion, and response; choose the next step that fits the actual shape of the moment.
